text: This motion seeks to rescind the existing vehicle parking zone on the west side of St. Helen's Avenue, north of Whytock Avenue, and have it replaced with a commercial loading zone in order to facilitate loading/unloading by local businesses.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing delivery vehicle parking zone on the west side of St. Helen’s Avenue, between a point 35 metres south of Dublin Street and a point 69 metres further south, in effect for a maximum period of 30 minutes, from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Saturday.
